audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 3-6 read Skill, Wukong, Skill, Wukong against the packet chart's Kayle, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle — and against the page's own whys, which say Kayle flips at 6 and out-scales outright. Difficulty 8.5/10 also did not match a 53.47% win rate over 707 games.
audit.why: Wukong is finite and item-dependent; the armour he stacks is a dead stat against Kayle's magic damage, and past 6 he must reach melee range to threaten her.
audit.corrected: Wukong, Wukong, Wukong, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle. Difficulty 6/10, Wukong carry threat 6/10.

audit.why: Four spikes present and consistent: Wukong levels 1-3, Kayle 6, Kayle first item, Kayle 2+ items.
audit.corrected: Unchanged; phase whys realigned to them.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tracks Nimbus Strike but never mentions that Crushing Blow is an auto-attack reset, so the reader watches for the wrong cue.
audit.why: His combo opens with an auto reset — the attack wind-up, not the ability cast, is the moment to step back. That is the difference between eating the armour-shred burst and dodging it.
audit.corrected: Stated in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[2].d and report[5].t.
